item.title: Next steps for BPF support in the GNU toolchain
item.description:
📝 It can also work with an under-development "CTFv4" format that adds support for some of the trickier cases. Alexei Starovoitov questioned the need for these features, saying that BTF is a kernel-specific format that does not have to support user space. That is a relatively new objective, he added; the previous goal had been to produce something that worked at all, with no ambitions beyond that.
🔗 Read more: https://lwn.net/Articles/1039827/

item.title: Ask HN: How to stop an AWS bot sending 2B requests/month
item.description:
📝 I have been struggling with a bot– 'Mozilla/5. I've submitted several complaints to AWS to get this traffic to stop, their typical followup is: We have engaged with our customer, and based on this engagement have determined that the reported activity does not require further action from AWS at this time. Are there others that have similar experience.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45613567
